title: Round Church, Preslav
geometryBasis: Named native perimeter and atrium way, with the Archaeological Museum’s 10.50 m inner sanctuary diameter and twelve radial bays.
sectionBasis: Seven June 2010 and August 2009 exterior photographs establish the open ruin, white restoration, exposed lower rubble, well, arches and partial rotunda colonnade. Heights and floor relationships are approximate.
limitations: The model depicts the roofless archaeological site and restoration visible in the 2009–10 photographs. Individual broken courses, stucco edges, column repairs and exposed details are simplified.
The two mapped outlines and the 10.50 m naos dimension control the plan. The spacing and height of the surviving niches, portals and partial arcade are estimated from ground-level photographs.

The original source field remains unchanged. Floors and lower retaining faces follow approximate grades. The placement opens ground only inside the mapped ruin where the modeled floor covers it, so flat viewer terrain does not obscure the descending court and naos.
